changes.comment: Move harness business rules (strategy choice, plan evidence scope, registration commands, stale and precondition checks, foreign hook and registration state rules) from application use cases into their owning domain contexts; a restored cli-registration no longer lists an unregister command apply never runs, and doctor's hook audit now also reads other agents' settings files a runner executes that the owner's adapter no longer lists (Claude Code's settings.local.json for Grok).
